'''Zera''' is the innkeeper at [[The Bunch of Grapes]] in the [[Foregate]] district of [[Cairhien (city)|Cairhien]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Zera}} Despite the inn's location she is herself not actually Cairhienin. {{ref/book|2|26}}

==Activities==
Zera cautioned [[Thom]] about getting involved in the Game of Houses.{{ref/book|2|26}} When Thom killed [[Galldrian|King Galldrian's]] men for murdering [[Dena]], Zera offered to take care of the bodies while Thom sought revenge.{{ref/book|2|34}}
